It keeps the existing light/dark preference untouched and layers a translucent surface-token override plus a global backdrop-filter on top, giving the whole UI an iOS/macOS-style frosted-glass look.","id":"gh:1333342552","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-webUI-Glass-Theme","slug":"makuralymi/dsh-webUI-Glass-Theme","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A global frosted-glass (backdrop blur) theme plugin for the dsh Web UI. It keeps the existing light/"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dark preference untouched and layers a translucent surface-token override plus a global backdrop-fil"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ter on top, giving the whole UI an iOS/macOS-style frosted-glass look."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-client-ui-frosted-glass"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **global frosted-glass (backdrop blur) theme plugin** for the dsh Web UI. It keeps the existing li"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ght/dark preference untouched and layers a translucent surface-token override plus a global `backdro"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"p-filter` on top, giving the whole UI an iOS/macOS-style frosted-glass look."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The plugin also adds a **Transition & schedule** row right below **Appearance** in Settings → Genera"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"l, plus a new **Theme settings** section in the settings navigation:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Transition & schedule** (General → below Appearance): switch animation + scheduled switching (se"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"e below).
- **Theme settings** section: contains the **custom background** (static images + dynamic "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"wallpaper videos), the **lighting effect** switch and the **system notifications** switch (see below"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"llpaper videos), the **lighting effect** switch and the **system notifications** switch (see below)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Switch animation**: None / Fade / Circle reveal / Wipe from top — full-screen transitions when l"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ight/dark is switched.
- **Scheduled switching**: set a daily dark-theme time and light-theme time; "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"the UI switches automatically at those boundaries, and manual switches last until the next boundary."},{"id":"p7s4","text":"
- **Custom background** (Theme settings): static images (URL / local) and dynamic wallpaper videos "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"(video URL / local file), with one-click reset to the built-in background.
- **Slideshow** (Theme se"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ttings): images and videos share one playlist; configure switch interval and animation; the playlist"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" modal supports preview, reorder, delete and add.
- **Lighting effect** (Theme settings): a blue glo"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"wing edge and halo around the composer, recolored in real time from the theme's brand token; from th"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"e moment the conversation starts running until it completes, the glow turns into a rainbow flowing a"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"round the border, then reverts. Can be switched off at any time.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Screenshot"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Two browser-side halves:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. **Global stylesheet** (inlined by `lib/client.js`)
- Paints `bg.jpeg` as a centered, cover backgr"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ound on `body` (inlined as base64; source kept at `assets/bg.jpeg`), shown as-is in light mode and d"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"immed behind a translucent dark veil in dark mode — the content the blur reveals.
- Applies `backdro"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"p-filter: blur(...) saturate(...)` to the three-column shell frame and to floating surfaces (`[role="},{"id":"p11s5","text":""menu"]`, `[role="dialog"]`, `[role="listbox"]`, `[role="tooltip"]`, ...).
- A MutationObserver auto"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"-marks fixed/absolute panels that other plugins portal under `<body>`, giving them the same frosted "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"glass without any per-plugin adaptation.
- Strengthens the stock `--dsw-mask-blur` token so dialogs "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"/ image masks blur harder."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"2. **Translucent surface-token override** (via `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`)
- Rewrites `--dsw-alias-b"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"g-base`, `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2/3`, `--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`, `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill`, `--d"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"sw-specific-menu`, ... to translucent `rgba(...)`, each with a `{ light, dark }` pair.
- Because eve"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ry component reads `var(--dsw-*)`, this layer is class-name agnostic and survives shell re-hashing."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"3. **Theme-switch animations**
- Wraps `ctx.theme.setTheme` with the browser-native View Transition "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"API: the browser snapshots the REAL before/after frames and uses the new frame as the mask — fade, c"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ircle reveal centered on the click, or wipe from top — with no solid-color veil.
- Respects `prefers"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"-reduced-motion`; switches without an animation when the resolved scheme stays the same (e.g. “Syste"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"m” resolving to the current scheme), and falls back to an instant switch where View Transitions are "},{"id":"p13s6","text":" to the current scheme), and falls back to an instant switch where View Transitions are unavailable."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"4. **Scheduled light/dark switching**
- When enabled, a timer is scheduled for the next “dark theme "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"at” / “light theme at” boundary and uses the same animated switch path.
- Preferences persist under "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"the `ui-theme` section of the user-settings document with `frosted*`-prefixed fields."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"5. **Custom background**
- Static images: URLs persist as `ui-theme.frostedBackgroundUrl`; local ima"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ges are compressed and stored in `localStorage`.

├── package.json          # dsh.bundle (self-inserting row) + dsh.clien"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"t (browser half)
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch: inserts the ui-frosted-glass row
├── lib/"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"
│   ├── index.js          # host half (desktop-wallpaper API route; wallpaper package + subprocess "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"fallback)
│   └── client.js         # browser half (window.__ModuleLoader__.load bundle format)
├── "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"README.md
└── README.zh.md"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`lib/client.js` is a hand-authored browser bundle in the same `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, fa"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ctory })` format tsdown emits — no local build step required."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Clone the repo, then install into the web profile via the profile plugin manager:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"git clone https://github.com/makuralymi/dsh-webUI-Glass-Theme.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"github.com/makuralymi/dsh-webUI-Glass-Theme.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-webUI-Glass-Theme"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"This runs pnpm in the profile directory and, because the package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, auto-a"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"dds it to `dsh.profile.bundles`; its bundle patch then inserts the `ui-frosted-glass` row automatica"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"lly — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` edit is needed. Then:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"dsh --profile web"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- The frame and composer-card `backdrop-filter` ride stable `data-*` attributes (`:has(> [data-shell"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"-overlay])` and `[data-composer-card]`) rather than hashed module classes; floating surfaces use `[r"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ole=...]`, and the translucent-token override is class-name agnostic.
- Third-party theme token over"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"rides are a runtime layer with no completeness validation; the frosted-glass layer intentionally ove"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"rrides only surface-background tokens, while the Monet themes also recolor brand/text/border/state t"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"okens.
- The Monet engine approximates Material You with OKLCH tonal palettes rather than the origin"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"al HCT solver; the generated ramps are perceptually even and seed-accurate, but not bit-identical to"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"e generated ramps are perceptually even and seed-accurate, but not bit-identical to Android's Monet."}],"truncated":true}
